title: How we're building the Arc Browser Windows app with *Swift*
summary: The Browser Company's CTO explains how the team is building the Arc browser for Windows using Swift. It covers the de-risking work and why they believe it is feasible.
why: Used mainly as evidence that Swift is being used for a real Windows application.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The Browser Company (The one that is hyping the Arc Browser) is writing their Browser in Swift to support Windows.
